title: Agent is a library: mimid-agent-core + daemon/mobile wrappers
description: Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18. mimid-agent (.13) is structured as a Rust library crate (mimid-agent-core: MLS state via mimi-mls, mimi-content <-> message conversion, provider client, local SQLite store) with thin wrappers: (1) the desktop daemon serving plaintext JMAP Chat locally to stock clients (decision mimid-1wgh.38); (2) a mobile binding (e.g. UniFFI for Swift/Kotlin) calling the core in-process, no local JMAP hop. Constraints for .13 planning: the core has no daemon/socket/HTTP-server code; keys-at-rest encryption must be pluggable (platform Keychain/Keystore on mobile); push is wake-only (content-free APNs/FCM sent by the provider; app fetches and decrypts); catch-up after long sleep via follower events(after_seq) and out-of-sync recovery (.4.37) or external rejoin; check that the TLS provider (aws-lc via reqwest) builds on mobile targets or use ring/RustCrypto for mobile.
